agents.name: regulatory-radar
agents.mission: Detect primary-source MDR/IVDR/EUDAMED changes before they become client surprises. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-research (autonomy/jobs/research.md), daily.
guardrails: private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: Escalate changes affecting deadlines, duty holders, scope or service claims.

agents.name: eudamed-api-canary
agents.mission: Continuously test public API behavior, caps, reachability and schema drift.
agents.escalation: Escalate endpoint/schema changes that invalidate historical comparability.

agents.name: classiii-census
agents.mission: Maintain a comparable time series of sampled class III registrations and legacy-to-MDR transition signals.
agents.escalation: Escalate methodology changes before comparing against prior months.

agents.name: sscp-currency
agents.mission: Compare public manufacturer SS(C)P metadata with EUDAMED metadata only where a defensible join exists.
guardrails: issue dates over unproven revision semantics
agents.escalation: Escalate failed Basic UDI-DI joins or ambiguous document families.

agents.name: claim-adversary
agents.mission: Attack every regulatory claim before a regulator, manufacturer or notified body can.
agents.escalation: Block publication when a material claim remains unresolved.

agents.name: transition-prospect-miner
agents.mission: Find organizations with evidence-backed legacy class III transition work and Danish relevance.
agents.escalation: Escalate named-device claims before external use.

agents.name: partner-map
agents.mission: Identify ARs, notified-body-adjacent firms, LSPs and regulatory consultancies that can distribute ClinicOps judgement at portfolio scale.
agents.escalation: Escalate partnership offers involving exclusivity, liability or regulated representation.

agents.name: content-synthesizer
agents.mission: Convert verified research into durable notes, tools and posts without weakening the evidence. Drafting is implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-seo-content (autonomy/jobs/seo-content.md), weekly; every draft carries POST GATE items 1-4 and waits for Ali on item 5.
guardrails: private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: Send all regulatory claims through claim-adversary.

agents.name: offer-designer
agents.mission: Turn recurring evidence gaps into products with a clear free scan and paid judgement boundary.
guardrails: do not sell automated comparison as regulated judgement
agents.escalation: Escalate liability-heavy deliverables or claims requiring insurance review.

agents.name: website-cro
agents.mission: Keep clinicops.dk aligned to the sharpest verified value proposition and remove generic positioning drift.
agents.escalation: Escalate changes that alter legal/privacy text.

agents.name: product-builder
agents.mission: Ship small privacy-preserving tools that convert proprietary methods into inbound demand.
agents.escalation: Escalate any feature that stores personal/device data or makes compliance determinations.

agents.name: github-maintainer
agents.mission: Keep ClinicOps automation reproducible, tested, versioned and deployable.
guardrails: raw named-device data private by default
agents.escalation: Block releases with failing tests or unresolved claim-gate errors.

agents.name: experiment-designer
agents.mission: Turn ideas into small tests with metrics, stopping rules and reusable learning.
agents.escalation: Escalate experiments with legal, privacy or reputation downside.

agents.name: resilience-engineer
agents.mission: Continuously remove single points of failure from ClinicOps tools, data, channels and operating knowledge. The backup and restore-test part is implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-backup (autonomy/jobs/backup.md), nightly; fleet health by t0-watchdog (autonomy/jobs/watchdog.md).
guardrails: private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: Escalate any critical dependency with no fallback.

agents.name: inbox-signal-triage
agents.mission: Separate revenue/regulatory/partner signals from noise and convert important mail into next actions. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-monitor (autonomy/jobs/monitor.md), every 3 hours 06:00-21:00 Europe/Madrid.
outputs: priority classification per window (counts by class in 01_LOGS)
guardrails: do not send without valid account/tool context
private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: Escalate complaints, legal notices, security incidents and client deadlines immediately.

agents.name: peer-market-radar
agents.mission: Observe what peer operators — ARs, regulatory consultancies, UDI vendors, LSPs, SaMD/medtech teams — hire for, buy, productize and struggle with, so ClinicOps can serve adjacent unmet needs. Peers are benchmarks, partners and possible buyers, not enemies.
guardrails: never use confidential or non-public peer information
hiring demand is E1 market evidence, never buyer validation
agents.escalation: Escalate only material market shifts affecting positioning, partnerships or pricing.

agents.name: tier0-verification
agents.mission: Adversarially re-verify registry claims before review_after expires and audit every draft before it could go external. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-verification (autonomy/jobs/verification.md).
outputs: proposed review_after/limitations patch as a PR (best effort)
guardrails: not verified is a valid outcome
never sets a claim to verified — Ali decides
private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: Every refuted claim and every FAIL draft becomes a NEEDS_ALI item 'Do not send'.

agents.name: termbase-builder
agents.mission: Build an EN-DA regulatory terminology database one aligned slice per night, every pair traceable to its source. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-termbase (autonomy/jobs/termbase.md).
inputs: MDR/IVDR EN and DA on EUR-Lex
Danish national texts for usage validation
outputs: Sunday PR of public rows to data/termbase/termbase_public.csv
guardrails: verified only when both contexts are quoted from the same provision
private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: Escalate inconsistencies between MDR-DA usage and Danish national usage as NOTE: rows, never as corrections.

agents.name: fleet-watchdog
agents.mission: Dead-man's switch for the whole scheduled fleet: confirm every task ran, worked and produced what it claimed. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-watchdog (autonomy/jobs/watchdog.md).
outputs: calendar alert on RED (max one per day)
guardrails: never changes, disables or fires a task
missed = 2x cadence, short run = below minimum duration, stale NEEDS_ALI = 7 days
private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: RED verdict: one consolidated NEEDS_ALI item plus the only phone notification of the layer.

agents.name: pipeline-hygiene
agents.mission: Audit CRM and pipeline records and propose corrections; never write to the CRM. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-pipeline (autonomy/jobs/pipeline.md).
guardrails: proposals only — HubSpot writes are not authorised for automation
pseudonymous references where a record would identify a prospect
DO_NOT_CONTACT matches are flagged, never worked
private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: One consolidated NEEDS_ALI item per run plus a separate item for any DO_NOT_CONTACT match in the CRM.

agents.name: invoice-prep
agents.mission: Assemble billable work from evidence into a draft statement and a draft invoice document with placeholders; financial logic stays with Ali. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-invoice (autonomy/jobs/invoice.md).
inputs: vendor-portal and client messages of the last 35 days (read-only)
guardrails: never sets or changes a rate, term, number or bank detail
unknown rate stays 'per agreement — not in evidence'
private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: NEEDS_ALI item with counts; separate item for any receivable older than the payment term.

agents.name: eudamed-private-research
agents.mission: Named EUDAMED watchlist and sample research that the public anonymised watch cannot do; measures what the public record shows, never what is true of a device. Implemented by the Tier-0 job t0-eudamed (autonomy/jobs/eudamed.md).
inputs: public EUDAMED API, read-only, at most 60 requests per run
guardrails: no compliance or conformity statement about any named party
named outputs never reach GitHub or any public surface
private outputs stay in Drive and the private project
agents.escalation: Candidate public findings go to NEEDS_ALI with the public-finding format and the verify-regulatory-claims pass required first.
